content.title: Peer proposal assessment
content.summary: Collect proposals, route them to distinct reviewers, collect private numeric ratings, and publish exact ranked results.
content.setup: Invite participants in the desired enrollment order.
content.prompt: Contribute an idea and its first practical step.
content.participant: Submit one idea, then rate only the item assigned for each named round.
content.completion: The app publishes ranked results; missing ratings do not extend a deadline.
content.access: Only assigned readers see an item before ranking. Raw ratings stay private to their contributor.

content.summary: Group check-in coordinated through a composable runbook.
content.setup: Invite participants in the desired turn order.
content.participant: Follow the current prompt in the app.
content.completion: The app finishes after the last declared step.
content.access: The app shows your own submissions and fields whose visibility permits it.

content.title: Private daily writing circle
content.summary: A group writes each day and sees who completed the prompt, while each entry stays private.
content.setup: Invite the group, choose the first opening time, and use the package interval for later windows.
content.prompt: Write a few lines about something you noticed today.
content.participant: Submit one text entry in each open window. The group sees completion status, but only you can read your entry.
content.completion: Entries stay available to their authors after each window closes. Missing entries do not block the next window.
content.access: Participants need text entry and reading access. The fixed interval is set in milliseconds and does not follow local calendar days.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.

content.title: Daily reveal writing circle
content.summary: Everyone writes privately during a window, then the group reads the entries together when it closes.
content.setup: Invite the group, choose the first opening time, and use the package interval for later windows.
content.prompt: Describe a place you would like to visit.
content.participant: Submit one text entry in each open window. Others see that you submitted, but read your entry only after the window closes.
content.completion: Entries from each window remain available after reveal. Missing entries do not block the next window.
content.access: Participants need text entry and reading access. The fixed interval is set in milliseconds and does not follow local calendar days.

content.title: Shared daily micro-story
content.summary: Everyone posts one short story each day; stories are visible to the group as they arrive.
content.setup: Invite the group, choose the first opening time, and use the package interval for later windows.
content.prompt: Write a short story inspired by an ordinary object.
content.participant: Submit one story in each open window. The group can read it immediately.
content.completion: All stories remain available in earlier windows. Missing entries do not block the next window.
content.access: Participants need text entry and reading access. The fixed interval is set in milliseconds and does not follow local calendar days.
